games.headline: Brandon Miller scores 34 points as the Hornets beat the winless Heat 115-110
games.desc: — Brandon Miller scored 34 points and the Charlotte Hornets beat the winless Miami Heat 115-110 on Saturday, bouncing back from one of the worst losses in franchise history a night earlier.

games.headline: Cavaliers survive a late Nets rally to win home opener 125-121
games.desc: — Donovan Mitchell scored 22 points, Jarrett Allen added 21 points, and the Cleveland Cavaliers won their home opener, 125-121 over the Brooklyn Nets on Saturday night.

games.headline: Embiid posts triple-double with LeBron out to keep 76ers perfect in 127-116 win over Bucks
games.desc: — Joel Embiid had a triple-double with LeBron James out, Jaylen Brown scored 27 points on his 30th birthday and the Philadelphia 76ers remained undefeated with a 127-116 win over the Milwaukee Bucks on Saturday night.

games.headline: Young scores 25 points as the Wizards hold off Wilson and the Bulls for a 124-120 win
games.desc: — Trae Young had 25 points and nine assists, and the Washington Wizards held off the Chicago Bulls for a 124-120 victory on Saturday night.

games.headline: Wembanyama, Harper lead Spurs past short-handed Mavericks 122-106 for their first victory
games.desc: — Victor Wembanyama had 23 points, seven rebounds and four blocks, Dylan Harper scored 22 points and the San Antonio Spurs beat the Dallas Mavericks 122-106 on Saturday night for their first victory of the season.

games.headline: Durant scores 22, Sheppard hits five 3-pointers to lead Rockets to a win in Atlanta's home opener
games.desc: — Kevin Durant scored 22 points and both Reed Sheppard and Tari Eason had 19 points as the Houston Rockets beat the Atlanta Hawks 121-114.

games.headline: Jokic has triple-double, Murray scores 42 points in Nuggets' OT victory over Pelicans
games.desc: — Nikola Jokic scored eight of his 35 points in overtime and finished with 15 rebounds and 10 assists, and the short-handed Denver Nuggets rallied from down 23 to beat the New Orleans Pelicans 141-135 on Saturday night.

games.headline: Booker scores 43 points in Suns' 131-122 win over Warriors, who fall to 0-3
games.desc: — Devin Booker scored 43 points, Miles Bridges added 16 and the Phoenix Suns won their home opener for the fifth straight season by beating the short-handed Golden State Warriors 131-122 on Saturday night.
